concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence
concerns.text: Task T004 (full‑run) is scheduled before the data‑acquisition and preprocessing tasks (Phase 3, US‑1). T004 requires the preprocessed `data/results/full_run.parquet` which is produced by the US‑1 pipeline (e.g., T017 ROI extraction, T018 QC). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence
concerns.text: Tasks T005 and T006 also depend on the outputs of the full run (tables, figures) that in turn rely on the preprocessing and modeling artifacts generated in Phases 3 and 4. Placing them before those producer tasks violates the foundational‑first principle.
